$comment: Bug categories for project sessions (repository debugging tasks). Each bug a project plants names one; a recorded session appends a `project:<id>` review event per category it exercised. Keep ids stable: changing one orphans its review history.

patterns.name: ORM queries
patterns.blurb: QuerySet filters that are never chained back, the wrong lookup (__gte for __lte, exact for iexact), ordering, counts, and N+1 queries.

patterns.name: Pagination
patterns.blurb: Parsing page and page_size from the query string: defaults, non-numeric and out-of-range values, caps, and the page past the end.

patterns.name: Caching
patterns.blurb: Cache keys, TTLs, and eviction: every write that changes a cached object must invalidate it.

patterns.name: Input validation
patterns.blurb: Missing, blank, malformed, or out-of-range request fields answered with 400 and an error body instead of a 500 or a bad row.

patterns.name: HTTP semantics
patterns.blurb: Status codes (201 on create, 404 for missing, 405 for wrong methods, 409 for conflicts) and the shape of responses.

patterns.name: URL routing
patterns.blurb: URL patterns, path converters, include(), trailing slashes, and the view a route actually reaches.

patterns.name: Models
patterns.blurb: Field defaults and constraints, relations and on_delete, computed properties, and save() overrides.

patterns.name: Serializers
patterns.blurb: Django REST framework serializers: fields, read_only and required, validate_<field> and validate(), and what to_representation returns.

patterns.name: Auth and permissions
patterns.blurb: Who may read or change what: ownership checks, permission classes, and 401 against 403.

patterns.name: Business logic
patterns.blurb: Off-by-one comparisons, the wrong field in a rule, totals and rounding, and state transitions.
